name: Grand Industrial Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Grand Industrial Holding Co., Ltd. functions as a diverse commodity trading firm with operations spanning both China and international markets. The company primarily deals in various bulk agricultural products, notably oilseeds and edible oils such as palm, soybean, and rapeseed oil, facilitating their domestic and international trade, as well as direct sales to end-users. Beyond agricultural commodities, Grand Industrial's portfolio includes a wider range of staple goods, such as energy products, chemicals, metals, and rubber. To support these trading activities, it provides essential services like export management, warehousing solutions, and comprehensive logistics. Additionally, the company offers customs declaration and inspection services, along with localized distribution for its clients. Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Lianyungang, China, the company was formerly known as Lianyungang Ideal Group Co., Ltd. before adopting its current name in October 2016.
